text_block_list.text:
I came running up after hearing
Gold Ship's bizarre shrieks from the rooftop, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*...
The academy is safe... Don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Once again, we managed to protect the academy
from the threat of the great cosmos, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"I used up way too much energy...
Man, it's gonna take a while to recover... *sigh*"

Cosmic threats aside,
the physical exhaustion was very real, and their movements remained sluggish for a while afterwards...
